content.hebrew: אָז בְּהַר הַמּוֹר, קָרָא אֵל לְעָנָו,
content.transliteration: Az behar hammor, ḳara El le‘anav,
content.english: Then, on Mount Mor, God called to the humble one,
content.comments:
Mount Mor. Mount Sinai.
The humble one. Moses.

content.english: The faithful emissary, to take a census of His faithful;

content.hebrew: רָאשֵׁי בְשָׂמִים עֲשׂוֹת שֶֽׁמֶן לְמִשְׁחַת כֹּהֲנָיו;
content.english: And to make the finest spices into an oil, for anointing His priests;
And naṭaf, sheḥeleth, and ḥelbena as the spices for His delight,
content.comments: Naṭaf, sheḥeleth, and ḥelbena. Various aromatic substances.

content.hebrew: וּלְבוֹנָה זַכָּה, לִרְקֽוֹחַ קְטוֹרָה – תָּפִיק רְצוֹנָיו.
content.transliteration: Ulvona zakka, lirko’aḥ ḳetora – tafiḳ retsonav.
content.english: And pure frankincense, for mixing into incense—it will bring forth satisfaction for Him.
Behold, Bezalel, with all his knowledgeable [associates],
Is full of wisdom, to work with gold and stone,
And in woodcarving, and preparing silver for sockets,
And [building] the Tent of Meeting, and [fashioning] its vessels, [and] the laver with its base.
When He finished speaking on the mountain, one on one,
He gave him His two stone tablets.

content.hebrew: וְכִרְאוֹת הָעָם כִּי בֹשֵׁשׁ מֹשֶׁה בַּעֲנָנָיו,
content.transliteration: Vekhir’ot ha‘am ki voshesh Moshē ba‘ananav,
content.english: And when the people saw that Moses was tarrying in the clouds,
The throngs all gathered around Aaron.

content.hebrew: "קוּם עֲשֵׂה לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים, כִּי מֹשֶׁה אֵינָיו!"
content.english: “Arise, make us gods, for Moses is no longer!”
They exchanged their Glory for an ox—such a profound disgrace.

content.hebrew: "לֶךְ־רֵד, עָנָו, כִּי שִׁחֵת עַמְּךָ, וְעָצְמוּ זְדוֹנָיו;
content.english: “Go, descend, humble one, for your people have acted corruptly, and their crime is great;
Leave me alone, and may their eyes see their destruction!”

content.hebrew: וַיֶּעְתַּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל יוי, וַיְחַל פָּנָיו.
content.transliteration: Vayye‘tar Moshē el Adonai, vayḥal panav.
content.english: Moses prayed to Adonai, and beseeched His presence.
And Adonai changed His mind, and let go of His rage.
Moses stood at the entrance to the camp,
And he said: “Whoever is for Adonai—gird his loins!
And inaugurate himself today—even a father [should kill] his sons.”

content.transliteration: Vayye’asefu elav kol benē Levi, ne’emanav.
content.english: And all the Levites, His faithful ones, gathered around him.

content.hebrew: וּמֹשֶׁה לָקַח אֶת־הָאֹֽהֶל, וְנָטָֽהוּ לוֹ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה, מְלוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: UMoshē laḳaḥ et ha’ohel, venatahu lo miḥuts lammaḥanē, melonav,
content.english: Moses would take the tent, and spread it out outside the camp, as his dwelling place,

content.transliteration: Yelekh sham kol mevaḳḳesh Adonai bera‘yonav.
content.english: And whoever sought Adonai in their thoughts would go there.
[Moses] yearned to attain God’s mystery, His secrets,
[So] Adonai passed in front of his face,
Bursting through the heavens and their clouds,
And He showed him His back, and [Moses] saw awesome sights.

content.hebrew: קָרַן עוֹר פָּנָיו, כִּי יָרֵא מֵהַבִּיט הַשְּׁכִינָה בְּאִישׁוֹנָיו.
content.transliteration: Ḳaran ‘or panav ki yarē mehabbit hash’shekhina be’ishonav.
content.english: [Then] the skin of his face gleamed, for he was afraid to gaze at the divine presence with his eyes.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּחָרוֹ, וְגִלָּה לוֹ חֶזְיוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Barukh asher beḥaro veḡilla lo ḥezyonav,
content.english: Blessed is the One who chose him, and revealed visions to him,

content.hebrew: קהל: צֶֽדֶק וּמֵשָׁרִים, מִשְׁפְּטֵי אֵל וְדִינָיו.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Tsedeḳ umesharim mishpetē El vedinav.
content.english: Cong. [And revealed] justice and righteousness, divine statutes and rules.

content.hebrew: חזן: הַכֹּל יוֹדֽוּהוּ וִישַׁבְּחֽוּהוּ וְיַקְדִּישֽׁוּהוּ וְיֹאמְרוּ:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Hakkol yoduhu vishabbeḥuhu veyaḳdishuhu veyomeru:
content.english: Cantor. All acknowledge Him, and praise Him, and declare His holiness, and say:

content.hebrew: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּי־אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּֽאלֹהֵֽינוּ: (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: En ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים ככ:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. And You are Holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
